summary: Shortcuts in the project instance path panel can be saved to a file and loaded back into any project.
details: Right-clicking the Shortcut section header offers Save Shortcut Config and Load Shortcut Config; the file holds the shortcut paths, their nicknames, and the folders they sit in.
Dropping that file anywhere on the path panel loads the shortcuts too, keeping only the paths the open project has and asking before replacing shortcuts already there.
